answer.rationale: Invariants live in the domain: Quantity validates positive integers, Money.of validates non-negative cents, and Order.addLine enforces currency match. PlaceOrder only orchestrates construction, delegates to these, and wraps errors with line context. It has no duplicated checks or locks guarding domain rules.
